dimensions.enforcement_mechanism: One Helm release per Kubernetes Namespace; cluster-scoped resources avoided; ClusterRole binding refused by chart template policy.
Role + RoleBinding namespace-scoped; ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding not rendered by the chart; cross-namespace verbs unavailable to the workload ServiceAccount.
Kubernetes Secret resources per-namespace; pod env block consumes secrets via secretKeyRef indirection; cross-namespace secret mount blocked by Kubernetes default behavior.
Default-deny ingress and egress NetworkPolicy; operator-extended allowlist for database, LLM providers, Teams webhook, and kube-dns peers.
ResourceQuota + LimitRange applied per-namespace by the operator; chart template defines pod-level resources.requests and resources.limits only.
JSONL evidence log written under the tenant-specific workspace_root on the pod's persistent volume; cross-tenant fact promotion is an advisory boundary respected by the workspace facts pipeline.

Per-tenant cost tracking is advisory only; the cost_tracking.available capability stays at the project's declared default; per-tenant rollup is an operator dashboard pattern, not a chart-rendered surface.
